messages.text: Where is my order? email (email hidden)

Hi Trent, both are still at the warehouse, nothing shipped yet.

Shop····, the B30 with the free Power Kit, now ships November 7, 2026. That's a week later than the date I gave you before, sorry about that.

Shop····, the Magic Miner 40T, ships November 14, 2026. So the two land about a week apart.

Tracking goes to this email as soon as each leaves. You can follow the batches here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Anything else you want me to check?
Before you go, one thing: the B30 slipping a week, does that change anything for you, or are you happy to wait it out?
I am happy to wait it out just cant wait to get it. Its my frist miner

Nice, that first one landing is a good feeling.

Before it does, are you planning to point it at a pool, or solo mine against your own node?
I think i will join the harlo os pool with my magic miner 40t and my own pool with the b30

Good split, you get steady payouts on one and the lottery ticket on the other.

Last one from me: what made you want to run the B30 against your own node rather than both on a pool?

Either way, when they land, our Discord is the fastest place for setup help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
I dont know lol i am going to run the b30 at 24th for power cost and the magic miner at 30. And i like the look of the b30 in my living room where the magic miner i am going to put in my pc room

That's sensible. The B30 defaults to 24 TH in Harlo OS anyway, so living-room duty suits it, it stays quieter and cooler there.

Thanks for answering, Trent, and enjoy them both when they land. Dates stay November 7 for the B30 and November 14 for the 40T.

It's been a pleasure helping you. If you were happy with how we handled it, a word on Trustpilot would mean a lot: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com
See ya, Trent. Tracking hits this inbox as each one ships, and we're here if you want a hand setting them up.
